summary: Wake 07:00 London, 27 October: one pass of the source watch on the pack vault 7r83qic5, two phases each committed and pushed, vault in sync at head 6a96f221696a, the first full pass on sgit-ai v0.26.0. Timings on sgit 0.26.0 in the 79,000-file watch clone: first pull after the upgrade 4 min (cache and index build; the earlier up-to-date pull took 23.5 s), probe 7 min 14 s, watch 36 min 17 s, phase 1 commit 36 s and push 1 min 7 s (14,357 objects), phase 2 commit 7 s and push 26 s (150 objects), whole pass 46 min 28 s; data export 1 min 12 s (34 s on 0.25.0). Against 0.25.0 the commit and push are the same within noise; the extra time is the web (919 pages, 22 fetch errors). pack index verify: not run to the end (about 40 minutes; see board researcher-0002). Data: files/source-watch.json refreshed, 1,288 pages, 948 publishers, 14,441 snapshots, 79 runs. Card and register updated after the evidence vault moved (nnd3i8iw; 3ytzxm3g decommissioned), the card's model set to Sonnet. Not judged: whether any capture ends the statement on /compromise/. Nothing written to v1. team dev taken in at 0f075ff3.
